propositions: The deprecated bare environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all live code paths, with a tombstone registry entry added to fail loud when still-set
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model and per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL env vars remain active; only the bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL env channel is removed
All test files that set REBAR_LLM_MODEL and construct an LLMConfig must be retargeted to use surviving configuration rungs (config table, CLI override, or per-class env)
The tombstone check must wire into LLMConfig.from_env to fail loud only when the LLM stack loads, raising RemovedInputError as a BaseException immune to broad exception handlers
Hand-written documentation sites and operator runbooks must be reworded from 'deprecated' to 'removed' and all references to the env var stripped from live prose
